what: In a zero-gravity rapier world, 100 balls (radius 1, 30 on touch devices) spawn scattered in a 5-cell box at the center, and every frame an impulse of (normalized own position)×(-.2,-.4,-.2) gathers them to the center — pulled twice as hard vertically, giving a horizontally wide cloud (movement damping .75 · rotation damping .15 · bounce .8). The z that the cursor points at=Kinematic balls (radius 1) invisible at the 0 plane position are moved directly to push through the cloud, and every 1 second one ball is thrown back to the rear top (z -3.5~-2.5) so the cloud keeps churning. The balls glow in a color one tone darker than the background, and top and bottom spotlights (intensity 60) make a faint shadow (VSM) where they meet. data-fx-part="text" If present, that text is broken per character onto the back panel and drawn large (70% of the width at 18 characters), and made to undulate on a 36-second cycle with large-cell value noise. When turned off with fx:active, the camera pulls back from z 10 to 12 in 1s power3.inOut, the balls vanish in .5s, then the physics stops

options.pull: Push impulse x,y,z per frame (multiplied by the normalized position), default -0.2, -0.4, -0.2
options.rebirth: Interval for throwing a ball again (s), 0 means no throw. Default 1
options.fov: Camera vertical field of view (deg), default 75
options.enter: If 1, starts off and turns on right after attaching (when arriving from another page)
options.wobble: Strength (px) at which the text plate noise slides, default 2000
options.speed: Panel shimmer speed (deg/sec), default 10 — one full turn in 36 seconds
options.measure: Share of text column width in landscape, default .7
options.measure-tall: Text column width share on vertical screens, default .65
options.per-line: On landscape screens, how many character sizes the cell width is divided into (character size = Cell width ÷ this value, default 18
options.lines: In vertical view, cell height ÷ this value = Font size, default 16
options.fx:active: Event sent to the element — if detail.active is false it turns off, otherwise on. When physics is ready, the element emits fx:ready

note: Ball color is --fx-ball (default color-mix(in srgb, --kf-ink 14%, --kf-bg)) — emitted with the same color so at exposure 1.2 it reads one tone darker than the background. Glyph shape and color are read from the computed style of the text child (font-family·font-weight·color), and that child is hidden on screen only once the canvas is up. The original moves the cursor ball only while the pointer moves (no lag) and it starts at the center (0,0,0), so the cloud wraps around it and clumps. The original physics step follows the frame interval as is, but here it is clamped to 1/240~1/30 s. rapier is 2MB so it loads separately on attach (after three-global.js → three.cjs), and if it fails to load the cloud only glides over 2s into a flat ellipsoid spot. With reduced motion it stands there at once. pile-gather-push, which pushes the same rapier pile, is a different feel — it pulls ten model shapes proportionally by position and follows the cursor with lag
use:
Large text

— loads gsap · three-global.js · three.cjs first. To turn off, el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:active', { detail: { active: false } }))
